You’ll hone your overall technique by learning new paddle strokes, strengthening your core, and learning how to make more efficient use of your muscles. Whether you’re looking for an introduction to paddleboarding or an advanced lesson, our Paddle Canada Certified Instructors will tailor an experience to your needs. Reservations are required.
